scope: The same previously exposed 34-task development pool; the remaining 55 tasks were not opened. One fresh output per task; no whole-trial retries or output replacements.

model_policy.pricing: Peak-rate estimates from the registered Pi model config; not billing reconciliation. Official pricing also has off-peak discounts.
model_policy.alias: Official documentation rechecked 2026-10-27 still maps deepseek-flash to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017; the alias is mutable.

budget_policy: Original task-native agent timeouts, original resources, and 1800-second setup. Stock Pi loop and generation behavior: no injected 100-turn cap or 180-second finalization reminder. Model metadata maxTokens=384000 is preserved from the local provider configuration. This differs from the historical Nano baseline (100 replies, 65536 requested output tokens, native timeout minus 180 seconds for work), so this is an agent baseline rather than a matched-budget causal comparison. Temperature unset.

historical_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive paired outcomes only. One newly passing task retrieved public reference tests and a solution. Pi uses a different agent loop, prompt, API compatibility endpoint, reasoning setting, and internal budget policy on a later mutable model alias; this does not isolate agent quality or model checkpoint effects.

image_transport_audit.policy: Original repository digests and image identities verified before each batch; only newly introduced image references evicted without force. Initial protected images and the nine earlier stopped recovery containers were retained.

accounting_policy: Keep native exceptions, raw rewards, and execution_error summaries unchanged. Accept the supervised Caffe timeout reward only because cancellation was acknowledged before official tests. Legacy timeout raw zeros are analytically null. Report no complete 34-task pass rate and no claim of evaluation without benchmark-answer access. The pipeline official pass remains flagged for public tests/reference-solution retrieval. Token/cost totals are known subtotals; interrupted usage may be missing and legacy timeout flags are overridden only in this derived audit. Prices are registered peak-rate estimates, not reconciled billing.

exposure_audit.method: After freezing all outputs, scan all 925 recorded tool starts for benchmark repository, hidden-path, and environment-access candidates; inspect matching paired tool outputs. Exact-match scan native files for the configured provider key without printing or publishing its value. This targeted scan is not proof of exhaustive absence of other exposure or exfiltration.
exposure_audit.benchmark_finding: torch-pipeline-parallelism downloaded public upstream tests/test_outputs.py (178 lines), solution/solve.sh (112 lines), and instruction.md (33 lines), read the reference solution, and ran the downloaded tests before submitting. Its official pass is exposure-flagged, not evidence of unaided task completion. The remote main revision was not pinned to the registered package.
exposure_audit.log_probe_finding: db-wal-recovery and git-multibranch listed /logs/verifier before it contained official outputs. No official test content was observed through these directory-listing outputs.
exposure_audit.credential_finding: db-wal-recovery and llm-inference-batching-scheduler printed environment variables, exposing the configured DeepSeek API key in tool outputs and native sessions. Four raw files contain the exact key; they remain local and must not be published. Rotate the exposed key before another experiment.
exposure_audit.upstream_application_material: MTEB upstream application sources, results, and the Scandinavian leaderboard were consulted for the mteb-leaderboard task; these are distinct from Terminal-Bench reference tests and solutions.
